time_class.instructions: What kind of physician time does this description refer to? Choose unclear if the text does not say.

criteria.provider_admin: Administration or medical direction of a hospital department, unit, service or program
criteria.gme_teaching: Teaching or supervising residents or fellows in an accredited training program
criteria.professional: Medical or surgical care of individual patients
criteria.research: Research, whether sponsored or internally funded
criteria.leave: Leave, sabbatical or other paid time away

is_provider_component.instructions: Is this time spent on duties that benefit patients generally rather than care of individual patients, resident teaching, or research?
